A few thoughts:

1. This is different than 2.1.1 since this is a system-generated password sent over email typically, not a user-chosen password
2. I think these passwords should have a time limit
3. These passwords should  **_force a password change right away_** before the user can use the account (this is the standard flow for system-generated passwords for new accounts)
